scripts.features: Automatically attacks players around you within six studs
scripts.script:
--[[

    Auto Attack (Killaura)
    Kills the closest player towards you
    -- [ stav.lua ] --

]]

shared.Aura = true

local cloneref = cloneref or function(obj)
    return obj
end
local playersService = cloneref(game:GetService('Players'))
local replicatedStorage = cloneref(game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'))
local lplr = playersService.LocalPlayer

local function getClosestPlayer()
    local closestdist, closestplr = math.huge, nil
    for i,v in playersService:GetPlayers() do
        if v == lplr then continue end

        pcall(function()
            local dist = lplr:DistanceFromCharacter(v.Character.PrimaryPart.Position)
            if dist < 6 and dist < closestdist then
                closestdist = dist
                closestplr = v
            end
        end)
    end

    return closestplr
end

task.spawn(function()
    repeat
        local plr = getClosestPlayer()
        if plr then
            replicatedStorage.meleeEvent:FireServer(plr)
        end

        task.wait()
    until not shared.Aura
end)

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local frameexecutor = script.Parent.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("ExecutorFrame")
local open = false

-- Tween settings
local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(
	0.2, -- duration
	Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
	Enum.EasingDirection.Out
)

-- Function to fade all GUI objects inside the frame
local function FadeAll(guiObject, transparency)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(guiObject:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("TextLabel") or descendant:IsA("TextButton") or descendant:IsA("TextBox") then
			TweenService:Create(descendant, tweenInfo, {
				TextTransparency = transparency,
				TextStrokeTransparency = transparency
			}):Play()
		elseif descendant:IsA("ImageLabel") or descendant:IsA("ImageButton") then
			TweenService:Create(descendant, tweenInfo, {
				ImageTransparency = transparency
			}):Play()
		elseif descendant:IsA("Frame") then
			TweenService:Create(descendant, tweenInfo, {
				BackgroundTransparency = transparency
			}):Play()
		end
	end
	-- Also apply to the main frame
	TweenService:Create(guiObject, tweenInfo, {
		BackgroundTransparency = transparency
	}):Play()
end

script.Parent.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
	if not open then
		frameexecutor.Visible = true
		FadeAll(frameexecutor, 0) -- fade in

		frameexecutor:TweenPosition(
			UDim2.new(0.017, 0, 0.017, 0),
			Enum.EasingDirection.Out,
			Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
